column1: # Bank / inventory sort rules (::sortbank, ::sortinv, "Sort" ops). Tab-separated.
#   First matching rule wins, top to bottom. Items in a tab are grouped by the rule that matched
#   them, in file order (so rule order is also display order), then by tier, name and dose.
#   tabs: combat tools ammo consumables herblore raw processed farming misc main
#     exact <name>     whole name           prefix <text>   name starts with
#     suffix <text>    name ends with       word <text>     whole word(s) anywhere in the name
#     iop <text>       has this inventory op (e.g. Eat, Drink, Bury, Break)
#     wearpos <slot>   head back neck weapon body shield legs hands feet ring ammo
#     stackable-weapon a stackable item worn in the weapon slot (darts, knives, thrownaxes)
#     untradeable      any item that can't go on the Grand Exchange
#   Material / tier words for ordering (lowest first). The longest matching word sequence in the
#   name wins ("black d'hide" beats "black"). In the combat tab, a tier word the name STARTS with is the gear
#   SET: a set's pieces stay together, sets ordered by tier, pieces in slot order
#   (head body legs hands feet shield weapon back neck ring ammo). Named sets come from the
#   Grand Exchange item-set enum when no tier word matches.
# ---- Main tab first: coins (main also catches anything unmatched and tradeable, at the end).
# ---- 2 Tools & teleports (before combat: axes/pickaxes are wieldable).
# ---- 1 Combat gear: everything else you can wear.
# ---- 9 Quest & misc: untradeables nothing else claimed. Main: the rest.
# Herbs (also orders seeds and unf potions).
# Runes (whole "<x> rune" so "Fire cape" isn't a fire-rune set).
